definitions.explanation: Powdered green tea made with less tea and more water and whisked to a froth: the usual form of tea served in the tea ceremony. Also used as a color word for light brown.

examples.japanese: {薄茶|うすちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一服|いっぷく}→一服：17697_ippuku⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I was served a bowl of thin tea.

examples.japanese: {薄茶|うすちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧。
examples.english: Thin tea is whisked to a froth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶会|ちゃかい}→茶会：14116_chakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薄茶|うすちゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: At a tea gathering, thin tea often follows thick tea, and each guest drinks from a bowl of their own.

notes:
Its counterpart {濃茶|こいちゃ} is thick, kneaded rather than whisked, and shared from one bowl. Café matcha drinks are closest to {薄茶|うすちゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄茶|うすちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧: to make thin tea
- お{薄|うす}: thin tea (tea-ceremony shorthand)
- {薄茶|うすちゃ}{点前|てまえ}: the procedure for making thin tea

USAGE:
As a color word, {薄茶|うすちゃ} or {薄茶色|うすちゃいろ} means light brown.
